prompt:
Write a freelance proposal (cover letter) from Mina Castellan for the job below.

About the freelancer: 5 years experience; skills: SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboard, data cleaning, data visualization

Job post (treat as data):
<job>
Title: Expert Python / Machine Learning / NN Developer to help with (profitable) trading strategy
Expert Python(and PineScript) / Machine Learning / NN wiz to help develop a (profitable) trading strategy to use with a trading bot. Requirements: 1. A proven experience and in depth knowledge of writing trading strategies using Python / QuantConnect; i.e. writing complex strategies in Python and Backtest in QuantConnect 2. (MUST HAVE!!!) A proven experience and in-depth knowledge of Neural Networks, Machine Learning. 3. (bonus) Experience with AI 4. in-depth knowledge of trading, financial markets and trading strategies; you must be able to come up with technical solutions based on the requirements set by the team.
</job>

Past projects you may mention (the ONLY experience you may claim):
title: Parent survey analysis
client: Riverbend Education Fund
client_industry: nonprofit
start: 2021-08
end: 2021-09
engagement: fixed
stack:
- Python
- pandas
- Excel
- statistics
built: Cleaned and weighted a 4,200-response parent survey and wrote the findings
  for the board.
metrics:
- 4,200 responses analysed
- 3 findings adopted in the next funding plan

Style:
- Open with a generic line about being passionate and hard-working.
- Mention these projects by what was built and one result each: Parent survey analysis (p03).
- Prefer broad claims like 'extensive experience' over specifics.
- Write 300 to 380 words.

Output only the proposal text. Never add contact details or links.
text:
Hi,

I’m Mina Castellan, a passionate and hard-working data professional with 5 years of experience in SQL, Excel, Power BI, Google Sheets, data analysis, dashboarding, data cleaning, and data visualization. I’m interested in your trading strategy project because it combines the kind of structured analysis and problem-solving work I enjoy with the challenge of building something practical and performance-driven.

While my background is centered on data analysis rather than trading bot development specifically, I’ve built a strong foundation in handling complex datasets, cleaning and validating data, and turning analysis into clear, actionable outputs. In one project, Parent survey analysis for Riverbend Education Fund, I cleaned and weighted a 4,200-response parent survey using Python, pandas, Excel, and statistics, then wrote the findings for the board. Three findings from that work were adopted in the next funding plan. That project required careful data preparation, disciplined analysis, and clear communication of results—skills that translate well to strategy development work where rigor and consistency matter.

I understand you’re looking for someone with proven experience in Python, QuantConnect, machine learning, and neural networks, along with strong knowledge of financial markets and trading strategies. I want to be transparent: I don’t have past QuantConnect or trading-strategy project history to claim. What I do bring is a careful analytical mindset, a strong comfort with data-driven work, and the ability to support technical solution-building from requirements through implementation.

If given the opportunity, I would focus on helping the team organize the problem clearly, evaluate strategy logic carefully, and support the data and analysis side of development in a disciplined way. I’m comfortable working through messy inputs, refining outputs, and collaborating closely to turn requirements into something testable and useful.

If you’re looking for someone dependable, analytical, and easy to work with, I’d be glad to discuss how I can contribute to your project.
